caseName: Asgrow Seed Co. v. Winterboer, Dba Deebees
caseNameFull: Asgrow Seed Co. v. Winterboer Et Al., Dba DeeBees

opinions.text: C. A. Fed. Cir. Motions of American Seed Trade Association, Intellectual Property Owners, and American Intellectual Property Law Association for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief in this case expressing the views of the United States.
